# Third-party material policy

External figures/images may be stored locally only when their use is
justified and legally permitted. The repository's own license (MIT /
CC BY-SA 4.0, see `LICENSE` and `LICENSE-CONTENT.md`) never applies to
third-party material — it remains under its original license or terms.

## Registry

[`SOURCES.yml`](SOURCES.yml) records, for every external asset: original
source, author, license/legal basis, and which lecture/lab uses it.

## Attribution

Registering an asset here is not sufficient on its own. Attribution must
also appear next to the figure where it is used (caption with author,
source, year, license, and a pointer to `third_party/SOURCES.yml`).

## Storage

Images live under `third_party/images/<context>/`; any license files that
must be shipped verbatim live under `third_party/licenses/`. Both are
created only once an actual asset needs them.
